I honestly don't write reviews often, but DIME Beauty's Hyaluronic Acid Serum deserves every bit of this praise. I've only been using it for ONE week, and I'm genuinely blown away by what it's done for my skin. My skin barrier was struggling, irritated, and just not looking or feeling healthy and somehow this serum completely changed that in days. My skin feels calmer, deeply hydrated, smoother, and healthier than it has in a long time. I pair it with DIME's Vitamin C Serum and tinted sunscreen every day, and this combination has seriously brought my skin back to life. My complexion looks brighter, more even, and so much more refreshed. It honestly feels like my skin barrier has been reset. If your skin feels dull, compromised, or like it needs a fresh start, this trio has been a total game changer for me. My skin has a whole new life.
